purpose: Re-run of the September 2026 synthetic experiments with the November 2026 code (same manifest, seed 42, 5 epochs).
environment: Linux CPU, Python 3.12.3, torch 2.14.0 (PyPI build, run on CPU), PennyLane 0.45.1, NumPy 2.5.3
conclusion: All thresholded metrics, AUC, confusion matrices and selected epochs are identical; losses and scores agree to float32 rounding. Elapsed time differs between machines and runs, so it is not a benchmark.
